history.name: Lnuc
history.desc: (LH + LHe + LZ) ! does not include photodisintegration

history.name: log_Lneu
history.desc: log10 power emitted in neutrinos, nuclear and thermal (in Lsun units)

history.name: log_Lneu_nonnuc
history.desc: log10 power emitted in neutrinos, thermal sources only (in Lsun units)

history.name: log_Lneu_nuc
history.desc: log10 power emitted in neutrinos, nuclear sources only (in Lsun units)

history.name: log_Lnuc
history.desc: log(LH + LHe + LZ) ! does not include photodisintegration

history.name: log_LZ
history.desc: log10 total burning power including LC, but excluding LH and LHe and photodisintegrations

history.name: log_power_nuc_burn
history.desc: total thermal power from all burning, including photodisintegrations

history.name: log_rotational_mdot_boost
history.desc: log factor for increase in mass loss mdot due to rotation

history.name: mass_conv_core
history.desc: (Msun) mass coord of top of convective core.  0 if core is not convective

history.name: max_entropy
history.desc: in units of kerg per baryon

history.name: min_dr_div_cs
history.desc: min over all cells of dr/csound (seconds)

history.name: min_dr_div_cs_yr
history.desc: min over all cells of dr/csound (years)

history.name: mixing_regions
history.desc: note: this includes regions where the mixing type is no_mixing.

history.name: model_number
history.desc: counting from the start of the run

history.name: nuc_timescale
history.desc: nuclear timescale (years) -- proportional to mass divided by luminosity

history.name: num_zones
history.desc: number of zones in the model

history.name: phase_of_evolution
history.desc: Integer mapping to the type of evolution see star_data/public/star_data_def.inc for definitions

history.name: photosphere_cell_T
history.desc: temperature at model location closest to the photosphere, not necessarily Teff

history.name: power_h_burn
history.desc: total thermal power from PP and CNO, excluding neutrinos (in Lsun units)

history.name: power_he_burn
history.desc: total thermal power from triple-alpha, excluding neutrinos (in Lsun units)

history.name: power_nuc_burn
history.desc: total thermal power from all burning, including photodisintegrations

history.name: rotational_mdot_boost
history.desc: factor for increase in mass loss mdot due to rotation

history.name: rsp_DeltaMag
history.desc: absolute magnitude difference between minimum and maximum light (mag)

history.name: rsp_DeltaR
history.desc: R_max - R_min difference in the max and min radius (Rsun)

history.name: rsp_GREKM
history.desc: fractional growth of the kinetic energy per pulsation period ("nonlinear growth rate") - see equation 5 in MESA5

history.name: rsp_num_periods
history.desc: Count of the number of pulsation cycles completed

history.name: rsp_period_in_days
history.desc: Running period, ie., period between two consecutive values of R_max (days)

history.name: rsp_phase
history.desc: Running pulsation phase for a cycle

history.name: star_age
history.desc: elapsed simulated time in years since the start of the run

history.name: star_age_day
history.desc: elapsed simulated time in days since the start of the run

history.name: star_age_hr
history.desc: elapsed simulated time in hours since the start of the run

history.name: star_age_min
history.desc: elapsed simulated time in minutes since the start of the run

history.name: star_age_sec
history.desc: elapsed simulated time in seconds since the start of the run

history.name: surf_c12_minus_o16
history.desc: this is useful for seeing effects of dredge up on AGB

history.name: surface_cell_entropy
history.desc: in units of kerg per baryon

history.name: time_step
history.desc: timestep in years since previous model

history.name: time_step_sec
history.desc: timestep in seconds since previous model

history.name: total_extra_heating
history.desc: extra heat integrated over the model times dt (erg)

history.name: v_div_csound_max
history.desc: max value of velocity divided by sound speed at face

history.name: v_div_csound_surf
history.desc: velocity divided by sound speed at outermost grid point

profile.name: acoustic_depth
profile.desc: sound time from surface to outer cell boundary (sec)

profile.name: acoustic_radius
profile.desc: sound time from center to outer cell boundary (sec)

profile.name: am_log_D_DSI
profile.desc: diffusion coeff for dynamical shear instability

profile.name: am_log_D_SSI
profile.desc: diffusion coeff for secular shear instability

profile.name: am_log_nu_non_rot
profile.desc: diffusion driven by other sources, e.g. convection

profile.name: am_log_nu_rot
profile.desc: diffusion of angular momentum driven by rotation

profile.name: cell_collapse_time
profile.desc: only set if doing explicit hydro

profile.name: cno_div_z
profile.desc: abundance of c12, n14, and o16 as a fraction of total z

profile.name: conv_vel_div_csound
profile.desc: convection velocity divided by sound speed

profile.name: conv_vel_div_L_vel
profile.desc: L_vel is velocity needed to carry L by convection; L = 4*pi*r^2*rho*vel**3

profile.name: conv_vel_div_mlt_vc
profile.desc: conv_vel from any convection model (including RSP) / mlt_vc, for comparison

profile.name: cp
profile.desc: specific heat at constant total pressure

profile.name: cs_at_cell_bdy
profile.desc: sound speed at cell boundary (csound is at cell center)

profile.name: delta_entropy
profile.desc: entropy - entropy_start, change during step (does not include effects of diffusion)

profile.name: diffusion_dX
profile.desc: change in h1 mass fraction from diffusion

profile.name: dkap_dlnrho_face
profile.desc: partial derivative of opacity wrt. ln rho (at T=const) at outer edge of cell

profile.name: dkap_dlnT_face
profile.desc: partial derivative of opacity wrt. ln T (at rho=const) at outer edge of cell

profile.name: dm_bar
profile.desc: boundary mass (grams) average of adjacent dm's

profile.name: dq
profile.desc: mass of zone as a fraction of total star mass

profile.name: dr
profile.desc: r(outer edge) - r(inner edge); radial extent of cell in cm.

profile.name: dr_div_R
profile.desc: cell width divided by star R

profile.name: dt_dv_div_dr
profile.desc: dt*dv/dr; need to have this << 1 for every cell

profile.name: dv
profile.desc: v(inner edge) - v(outer edge); rate at which delta_r is shrinking (cm/sec).

profile.name: dvc_dt_TDC_div_g
profile.desc: dimensionless ratio of convective velocity to g

profile.name: dwork_dm
profile.desc: cell specific work per unit time, Work = dwork_dm*dm*dt

profile.name: eps_nuc
profile.desc: ergs/g/sec from nuclear reactions (including losses to reaction neutrinos)

profile.name: eps_nuc_neu_total
profile.desc: erg/gm/sec as neutrinos from nuclear reactions

profile.name: eta
profile.desc: electron degeneracy parameter (eta >> 1 for significant degeneracy)

profile.name: flux_limit_lambda
profile.desc: flux limiter defined as in Levermore & Pomraning 1981

profile.name: flux_limit_R
profile.desc: flux ratio defined as in Levermore & Pomraning 1981

profile.name: Frad_div_cUrad
profile.desc: Frad/(C*Urad), must be < 1 to not violate c.

profile.name: free_e
profile.desc: free_e is mean number of free electrons per nucleon

profile.name: gam
profile.desc: plasma interaction parameter (> 160 or so means starting crystallization)

profile.name: gradL
profile.desc: gradient for Ledoux criterion for convection

profile.name: gradr
profile.desc: dlnT/dlnP required for purely radiative transport

profile.name: gradr_sub_grada
profile.desc: gradr - grada_face; > 0 => Schwarzschild unstable for convection

profile.name: gradT
profile.desc: mlt value for required temperature gradient dlnT/dlnP

profile.name: gradT_excess_effect
profile.desc: 1 - alpha, where alpha is the gradT_excess_alpha from mlt++

profile.name: gradT_rel_err
profile.desc: gradT - actual_gradT / gradT, actual_gradT = deltaT/deltaP from finite difference

profile.name: gradT_sub_a
profile.desc: same as gradT_sub_grada ! gradT-grada at cell boundary

profile.name: i_rot
profile.desc: specific moment of inertia at cell boundary

profile.name: include
profile.desc: Include another columns list file. `include ''` means include the default file.

profile.name: j_rot
profile.desc: specific angular momentum at cell boundary

profile.name: kap_frac_highT
profile.desc: fraction of opacity from highT tables

profile.name: kap_frac_lowT
profile.desc: fraction of opacity from lowT tables

profile.name: kap_frac_op_mono
profile.desc: fraction of opacity from OP mono

profile.name: kap_frac_Type2
profile.desc: fraction of opacity from Type2 tables

profile.name: lamb_S
profile.desc: lamb frequency for l=1: S = sqrt(2)*csound/r   (rad/s)

profile.name: lamb_S2
profile.desc: squared lamb frequency for l=1: S2 = 2*(csound/r)^2   (rad^2/s^2)

profile.name: log_column_depth
profile.desc: log10 column depth, exterior mass / area (g cm^-2)

profile.name: log_D_anon
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = anonymous_mixing

profile.name: log_D_conv
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = convective_mixing

profile.name: log_D_leftover
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = leftover_convective_mixing

profile.name: log_D_minimum
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = minimum_mixing

profile.name: log_D_mix
profile.desc: log10 diffusion coefficient for mixing in units of cm^2/second (Eulerian)

profile.name: log_D_ovr
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = overshoot_mixing

profile.name: log_D_rayleigh_taylor
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = rayleigh_taylor_mixing

profile.name: log_D_semi
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = semiconvective_mixing

profile.name: log_D_thrm
profile.desc: D_mix for regions where mix_type = thermohaline_mixing

profile.name: log_dr_div_R
profile.desc: log10 cell width divided by star R

profile.desc: J is j*1e-15 integrated from center; M53 is m^(5/3)

profile.name: log_J_inside
profile.desc: J_inside is j_rot integrated from center

profile.name: log_Ledd
profile.desc: log10(Leddington/Lsun) -- local Ledd, 4 pi clight G m / kap

profile.name: log_mlt_D_mix
profile.desc: log10 diffusion coefficient for mixing from mlt (cm^2/sec)

profile.name: log_sig_mix
profile.desc: sig(k) is mixing flow across face k in (gm sec^1)

profile.name: log_xr
profile.desc: log10 radial distance from point to surface (Rsun)

profile.name: log_xr_cm
profile.desc: log10 radial distance from point to surface (cm)

profile.name: log_xr_div_R
profile.desc: log10 radial distance from point to surface in units of star radius

profile.name: logE
profile.desc: log10(specific internal energy) at center of zone

profile.name: logfree_e
profile.desc: log10(free_e), free_e is mean number of free electrons per nucleon

profile.name: logR
profile.desc: log10(radius/Rsun) at outer boundary of zone

profile.name: logR_cm
profile.desc: log10 radius at outer boundary of zone (in centimeters)

profile.desc: logR = logRho - 3*logT + 18 ; used in kap tables

profile.name: logT_bb
profile.desc: log10(black body temperature) at outer boundary of zone

profile.name: logT_face
profile.desc: log10(temperature) at outer boundary of zone

profile.name: lum_rad_div_L_Edd_sub_fourPrad_div_PchiT
profile.desc: density increases outward if this is > 0

profile.name: luminosity
profile.desc: luminosity at outer boundary of zone (in Lsun units)

profile.name: m_grav
profile.desc: total enclosed gravitational mass. Msun units.

profile.name: mass
profile.desc: m/Msun. mass coordinate of outer boundary of cell.

profile.name: mass_correction_factor
profile.desc: dm_gravitational/dm (dm is baryonic mass of cell)

profile.name: mass_grams
profile.desc: mass coordinate of outer boundary of cell in grams

profile.name: mixing_type
profile.desc: mixing types are defined in mesa/const/public/const_def

profile.desc: The convective efficiency parameter from the mlt equation, Gamma=(grad-gradE)/(gradE-gradL)

profile.name: mlt_gradT
profile.desc: same as gradT, mlt/TDC value for dlnT/dlnP.

profile.name: mlt_vc
profile.desc: convective velocity from mlt/TDC in cm/s

profile.name: mlt_Y_face
profile.desc: The superadiabaticity Y = dlnT/dlnP - grada, or dlnT/dlnP - gradL at cell boundary

profile.name: mmid
profile.desc: mass at midpoint of cell (average of mass coords of the cell boundaries)  Msun units.

profile.name: mu
profile.desc: mean molecular weight per gas particle (ions + free electrons)

profile.name: net_nuclear_energy
profile.desc: erg/gm/s from nuclear reactions minus all neutrino losses

profile.name: nonnucneu_brem
profile.desc: bremsstrahlung (for reactions like e- + (z,a) => e- + (z,a) + nu + nubar)

profile.name: nonnucneu_pair
profile.desc: pair production (for reactions like e+ + e- => nu_e + nubar_e)

profile.desc: photon neutrinos (for reactions like e- + gamma => e- + nu_e + nubar_e)

profile.desc: plasmon neutrinos (for collective reactions like gamma_plasmon => nu_e + nubar_e)

profile.desc: recombination  neutrinos (for reactions like e- (continuum) => e- (bound) + nu_e + nubar_e)

profile.name: omega_crit
profile.desc: breakup angular velocity = sqrt(G M / equatorial^3)

profile.name: opacity
profile.desc: opacity measured at center of zone

profile.name: pgas
profile.desc: gas pressure at center of zone (electrons and ions)

profile.name: prad
profile.desc: radiation pressure at center of zone

profile.name: pressure
profile.desc: total pressure at center of zone (pgas + prad)

profile.name: psi_roche
profile.desc: dimensionless Roche potential at outer boundary of zone (only works if in a binary model and b% use_tidal_deformation is used; else is -99)

profile.name: q
profile.desc: fraction of star mass interior to outer boundary of this zone

profile.name: radius
profile.desc: radius at outer boundary of zone (in Rsun units)

profile.name: radius_cm
profile.desc: radius at outer boundary of zone (in centimeters)

profile.name: radius_km
profile.desc: radius at outer boundary of zone (in kilometers)

profile.name: rmid
profile.desc: radius at center by mass of zone (in Rsun units)

profile.name: rsp_dampR
profile.desc: Radiative cooling, D_r, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_Eq
profile.desc: Viscous energy transfer rate, epsilon_q, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_Hp_face
profile.desc: Pressure scale height at cell face

profile.name: rsp_log_dt_div_heat_exchange_timescale
profile.desc: Ratio of time step to heat exchange timescale

profile.name: rsp_Pt
profile.desc: Turbulent pressure, p_t, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_Pvsc
profile.desc: Artificial viscosity, p_av, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_sink
profile.desc: Sum of turbulent dissipation and radiative cooling terms

profile.name: rsp_src
profile.desc: Source function, S, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_src_snk
profile.desc: Convective coupling, C, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_Uq
profile.desc: Viscous momentum transfer rate, U_q, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: rsp_Y_face
profile.desc: Superadiabatic gradient at cell face, Y_sag, see Table 1 in MESA5

profile.name: sign_brunt_N2
profile.desc: sign of brunt_N2 (+1 for Ledoux stable; -1 for Ledoux unstable)

profile.name: tau_eff
profile.desc: tau that gives the local P == P_atm if this location at surface

profile.name: total_energy
profile.desc: specific total energy of cell (ergs/g). internal+potential+kinetic+rotation.

profile.name: vel_km_per_s
profile.desc: velocity at outer boundary of zone (km/s) -- 0 if no velocity variable

profile.name: velocity
profile.desc: velocity at outer boundary of zone (cm/s) -- 0 if no velocity variable

profile.name: w_div_w_crit_roche
profile.desc: ratio of rotational velocity to keplerian at the equator

profile.name: without
profile.desc: the contribution from the Eddington factor

profile.name: xr
profile.desc: radial distance from point to surface (Rsun)

profile.name: xr_cm
profile.desc: radial distance from point to surface (cm)

profile.name: xr_div_R
profile.desc: radial distance from point to surface in units of star radius

profile.name: ye
profile.desc: average charge per baryon = proton fraction

profile.name: zone
profile.desc: numbers start with 1 at the surface
